title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1980-05-04
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 >> Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: 2 x Nakamichi CM700 => Sony TC-D5M >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Great show with standout Franklin's Tower, captured on a clear audience recording.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it a "hell of a show" and highlighting the memorable (though mis‑named) Franklin's Tower. The recording is praised for its pleasant audience ambience and overall good sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and emphasize a strong performance and clear sound, but only two brief comments limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note an especially nice audience and great overall sound, suggesting a clean capture with good crowd presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing; reviewers simply describe the concert as an excellent overall experience.
